fields.name: schema_version
fields.description: Version of this state schema; recorded in every checkpoint.

fields.name: messages
fields.description: Messages of the current turn; history is mirrored in chat_messages.

fields.name: context
fields.description: Serializable execution context; the effects_applied ledger lives here.

fields.name: intent
fields.description: Compiled intent of the turn (intent-schema-v3): intent, parameters with confidence, high_impact_missing, contradictions; null only before compile_intent.

fields.name: clarification
fields.description: Clarification loop state: {pending_params, rounds}; questions are deterministic per-parameter templates (R-03).

fields.name: pending_action
fields.description: Proposed action awaiting an explicit decision; set to {kind: proposal, proposal_id} before every HITL interrupt (R-04).

fields.name: tool_calls
fields.description: Pending tool calls of the turn: {tool, args}; validated against the intent's allowed_tools policy; bounded by AGENT_TOOLS_MAX_CALLS_PER_TURN.

fields.name: tool_results
fields.description: Tool results of the turn: {tool, status, result|error_code}; redacted outputs only.

fields.name: errors
fields.description: Typed errors of the run; no conversation content.
